approval_abandon_body: Closing will treat this request as denied. The model will not run it.
approval_always_revoke: You can revoke this anytime in General settings · Always-allowed tools.
approval_collapse_body: Collapsing does not submit. The question stays above the input; tap “Answer” anytime to continue.
approval_collapsed: Collapsed for now. Tap “Answer” to continue.
approval_full_access_note: Once enabled, the permission button next to the input shows Full access. You can change it back anytime.
approval_mode_full: All actions run directly without asking.
approval_mode_manual: Deleting, running commands and changing files outside the workspace always ask you first.
approval_mode_subtitle: How to confirm dangerous actions before they run
approval_mode_workspace: Changes inside the workspace run automatically; actions outside it still ask.
approval_multi_hint: Multiple choice (you can also pick “Other” and type your own)
approval_risk_delete: · Delete or move any file directly
approval_risk_no_ask: · All of the above happen without asking, and cannot be undone
approval_single_hint: Single choice (you can also pick “Other” and type your own)
archive_hidden_hint: Archived items are hidden by default
folder_not_deleted: The folder itself will not be deleted
general_settings_subtitle: Font size · work steps · send when busy · max turns
level_applies_next_run: This turn has started; the new level applies from the next run
message_edit_hint: Put this message back in the input to edit and resend it
no_sessions_hint:
No sessions yet
Send a message to start one
output_format_error: The model’s output at this step had the wrong format, so nothing was executed.
output_retry: It has been asked to retry in the correct format.
re_confirm_body: This is the exact command that will run. Check paths before continuing.
re_intro: Every action runs in Termux only after you read the exact command and confirm it. Use these tools on apps you own or are authorized to analyze.
re_root_warning: Frida server needs root on the device. Without root, this step will fail.
re_storage_note: Files are read and written in Download/HeraclesRE. Run the storage setup once so Termux can access it.
run_auth_failed: Model authentication failed: the API key is invalid or lacks permission. Check it in Settings → Model.
run_auto_limit: Auto-continue reached 3 turns; the task is still not finished.
run_context_fix: Shorten the content, remove large attachments, or start a new task. Switching accounts won’t fix this.
run_context_hint: Context exceeds the model window: this input plus history is too long.
run_network_hint: Network connection failed. Check your connection and try again.
run_no_progress: No changes to files, tests or errors in two turns in a row
run_rate_limited: Model service rate limit: too many requests. Try again later.
run_resume_unknown: Can the run resume? Not reported.
run_timeout_hint: Model service timed out: the network or server is too slow. This turn was stopped.
send_queue_hint: Sending queues at the end; ↑ to jump the queue
single_list_empty: The workspace still exists, but “single list” shows sessions only, and there are none now.
stream_empty: No content was generated this turn
tap_plus_hint: Tap ⊕ in the top right to choose a workspace.
termux_command_note: This command will run in Termux and install the tools. Nothing runs until you confirm.
termux_confirm_body: Termux will open a session and install the packages. Check the command before continuing.
termux_err_background: Android blocked starting Termux from the background. Open this app and try again.
termux_err_unknown: The command could not be sent.
termux_external_apps_hint: In Termux, add allow-external-apps = true to ~/.termux/termux.properties, then restart Termux. This app cannot change that setting for you.
termux_intro: Engineering tools run inside Termux. Install Termux from F-Droid first (the Play Store version is outdated and cannot be used here).
termux_permission_hint: Grant the permission in Android Settings: Apps > Sellaoui Engineering AI > Permissions > Run commands in Termux environment.
termux_sent: Command sent to Termux. Follow progress there.
workspace_explainer: A workspace is the project folder the agent will work in.
